model: Aurora HydroLink for NXW/SKW Water-to-Water Heat Pumps
applies_to: WaterFurnace NXW and SKW dual-scroll water-to-water heat pumps (including header rack arrangements) with the Aurora HydroLink controller.
summary: BACnet objects of the Aurora HydroLink controller for NXW/SKW dual-compressor water-to-water heat pumps, software version 1.03. It covers setpoint, aquastat or network control of both compressors, load and source water temperatures and limits, refrigerant data per compressor, and header rack valve and loop control. Each point is marked for the configurations it applies to.
notes: The source marks writable points 'in1,in8,in16' without explaining it (most likely the BACnet priorities they accept); they are shown here as commandable (C).
Each point is ticked for one or more configurations (NXW HYDWWB01_01/_02 and several WCHDM dual scroll builds); header rack points only apply to header rack units.
AV 26 HeatingDifferential_c has no default or range values printed.
BV 511's state text (Inactive=Enumerated, Active=Numeric) disagrees with its description, which calls Numeric False; check on site.
MSV 3 option 4 names AV 12 as the network temperature, while AV 62 is described as the network temperature input.
The sheet does not state the BACnet transport or network settings.

source.title: Aurora HydroLink BACnet Points List For NXW/SKW

integration.summary: For units without a header rack, pick the control method on MSV 2 (aquastat, setpoint, network or setpoint with enable). In setpoint mode the HydroLink holds AV 22/23 against the input chosen on MSV 3; in network mode the BAS calls compressor A on BV 35 and B on BV 34. BV 37 must stay Enabled, and the BAS should set BV 36 to Network while it has control.

minimum_points.name: SystemEnable_c
minimum_points.why: System enable; compressors stay off when Disabled

minimum_points.name: NetworkControl_c
minimum_points.why: Set to Network while the BAS has control

minimum_points.name: AlarmReset_c
minimum_points.why: Alarm reset; return to Normal after the lockout clears

minimum_points.name: SystemStatus_st
minimum_points.why: Overall status: normal, alarm, shutdown, load shed...

integration.enable: BV 37 SystemEnable_c (default Enabled) must be Enabled, or the compressor outputs stay off except under manual override. The BAS should set BV 36 NetworkControl_c to Network when it takes control; many local commands and settings then stop working. With MSV 2 = 3 (Network), BV 35 and BV 34 call compressors A and B; BV 1 picks cool or heat. BV 2 EmShutdown_c forces an emergency shutdown.
integration.remote_sensors: AV 62 NetworkTemperature_c is the BAS-supplied control temperature for setpoint control on a network temperature (MSV 3 option 4, which the sheet labels AV 12). Header rack units take BAS cold, hot and geo loop temperatures on AV 506-508; values written to AV 510-515 take priority over the measured header temperatures. BV 503 switches the geothermal loop temperatures to network values.
gotchas: BV 5 EnableManualOverride_c lets BV 6-8 override compressor and reversing valve logic; the override does not stop the normal logic from running.
With BV 502 Active, all header rack valves follow the manual values (AV 563-567, BV 510).
Header rack mode comes from AV 568 or MSV 501, chosen by BV 511.
Clear BV 33 AlarmReset_c back to Normal once the lockout condition is gone.
Check the configuration columns in the source: many points only exist on some NXW/WCHDM builds.
